items.description: While Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky suggests he would sign up to a ceasefire on energy infrastructure, Russia has said little.

items.title: How exposed is Saudi Arabia? Yemen's Houthis scale up drone and missile attacks
items.description: How exposed is Saudi Arabia? Just as Iran’s retaliation to Donald Trump’s war suddenly exposed the vulnerability of neighboring Gulf states…how much is Riyadh reeling from the escalation with Yemen’s Tehran-backed Houthis? We’ll assess the physical and material damage from strikes on airports and oil facilities as well…

items.title: Why the Trump-Putin fuel agreement benefits Russia
items.description: As the sanctions regime on Russian oil crumbles and pressure on Ukraine mounts, the announcement of an energy ceasefire between Moscow and Kyiv faces obstacles due to Russian demands.

items.title: Can South Korea and Ukraine resolve their diplomatic spat over North Korean POWs?
items.description: Seoul and Kyiv are trading accusations after the transfer of two North Korean POWs to South Korea. The South insists the move was to be kept secret as it seeks to avoid antagonizing Pyongyang.

items.title: Russia Plans Rehab Centers for Ukraine War Amputees
items.description: Russian officials are reporting growing demand for prosthetic limbs and rehabilitation among soldiers returning from Ukraine.

items.title: Russia hits Ukraine gas facilities after Trump claims 'energy ceasefire'
items.description: Trump said he had brokered a cease-fire to protect energy infrastructure in Russia and Ukraine. But Ukrainian officials say bombs kept falling overnight on gas facilities, wounding 33 people.

items.title: Zelenskyy Says Ukraine Will Stop Refinery Attacks If Russia Halts Energy Strikes
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Russia of striking an energy plant after US leader Donald Trump's surprise announcement of an “energy cease-fire,” while Moscow remained silent on any suggestion of a truce.

items.title: Houthis, Saudis exchange strikes on airports as Mideast conflict intensifies
items.description: The Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen accuse Saudi Arabia of striking the rebel-held airport in Sanaa. This accusation comes amid escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces.

items.title: Houthi attack on Riyadh airport forces swift rethink of Trump’s new strategy

items.title: ‘These attacks must cease immediately’: Guterres condemns deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
items.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has condemned a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh’s main airport that Saudi authorities say killed 12 people and wounded more than 300.
